title: Winter Wellness: Staying Healthy This Season
excerpt: Cold and flu season is here. Our GPs share practical tips to protect your family's health through winter — from vaccination to boosting immunity naturally.
body: Winter brings increased risk of respiratory illnesses including influenza, COVID-19, and the common cold. Here are our top tips: Stay up to date with your flu vaccination — it's available now at Morley GP. Wash hands frequently, especially after being in public spaces. Maintain a healthy diet rich in vitamin C and zinc. Stay active indoors. Get plenty of sleep. If symptoms worsen or you're in a high-risk group, book an appointment early. Early treatment leads to faster recovery.
